g_17de33c9038b.title: Design a YAML storage backend for tinydb alongside JSONStorage

anchorAsk.text: The ops team wants to hand-edit some of our tinydb files, so I'd like a YAML storage next to JSONStorage. Have a look at how the storages are put together and tell me how you'd build it, including which YAML library and loader you'd use. Don't write it yet.
